title: Refine publication doctrine from explicit Monitoring review rationales
description:
Critical reusable Papyrus feature: private database-driven publication and section guidelines must govern research/writing, classification and copy editing. Publication policy prose and human editorial rationale remain private in local drafts or authenticated database records; public code/tests/issues use synthetic content only.

Current: generic source fixes are pushed in draft https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/382 . Code 0be5761e, permission test 27c667d2 and scoped-update regression 05cdf1dc; delivery/tracker head bbacf15c. 63 focused Python tests and 24 BDD scenarios/98 steps pass locally. Latest CI is running; prior collector head 4a151214 is green. Existing owner provider-secret preparation is preserved. No production policy, grant, deployment or live provider call changed.

Existing authenticated editorial context/pack commands are reused, not duplicated. Effective context carries scoped source revisions and hashes. Classification preflights current records, preserves the learned rubric separately and invalidates stable decisions after policy updates; stale prepared context is refused before transmission. Copy-editing combines doctrine with its separate same-key desk control overrides/additions and propagates it to actual Limatus judgment/rewrite constructors.

Acceptance remains open: verify selected consumer release inclusion, deployed permissions/API/procedure versions, correct authenticated publication/tenant/section scope, guest/reader denial, no other-desk leakage, current-value readback, inherited/additional/overridden rules, update invalidation and sanitized final provider-boundary traces. Use current private records, not seed files or repository assumptions. The proposed two private query reads for the existing editorial-checks function are getEditorialContext and listKnowledgeCorporaByRoleAndName; application requires a scoped reviewed consumer rollout. Production policy writes and live provider tests need exact target/scope and bounded budget approval. No public endpoint, credential creation or auth weakening.

Related: Monitoring pilot PPY-3212f123-2cc6-4464-b3b6-1c32bfbdda25; propagation story PPY-eba9cfd9-d3e1-467f-bbbd-1aa5f1aac362. Do not close on local tests alone.
